characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: A tall, regal figure with a somber demeanor, marked by a sense of loss. He has a strong build, a noble face with a beard showing signs of age, and wears majestic, traditional royal robes. The setting includes a grand room adorned with rich decor and a portrait of the late Queen, symbolizing his continued mourning and deep attachment to his daughter.

characters.name: Kongsdatteren
characters.description: A young, radiant princess with a gentle demeanor. She has a slim build, delicate features, and long, flowing golden hair. Initially seen in simple, worn clothing due to her hardship, but later adorned in stunning copper, silver, and golden dresses that mesmerize everyone in the church. Her setting includes enchanting forests, a humble grisehus, and a majestic castle, symbolizing her journey from adversity to rediscovered royalty.

characters.name: Stedmoren
characters.description: A stern and envious woman with a distinct aura of malice. She has sharp features, dark eyes filled with jealousy, and often wears dark, imposing gowns that reflect her bitter nature. Her setting often includes conniving with her daughter and dark corners of the castle where she plots against the King's daughter.

characters.name: Stedatteren
characters.description: A spiteful young woman marked by unattractive features and a constantly scornful expression. She mirrors her mother’s greed and ill intentions, usually seen in plain, unfashionable dresses. Together with her mother, she is often found in the shadows of jealousy within the castle walls.

characters.name: Den blå Studen
characters.description: A majestic, enigmatic ox with a gleaming blue hide and an aura of wisdom and kindness. Often depicted in serene and magical forest settings, it is not only a beast of burden but also a protector and guide for the King’s daughter. The blue ox holds a magical connection to nature and the ability to comfort and provide sustenance.

characters.name: Prinsen
characters.description: A charming and determined prince with noble features, well-kept hair, and a tall, confident stance. He is dressed in fine, princely attire that highlights his status. The prince is featured in both the castle and the church, always with a determined glint in his eyes, particularly when seeking the owner of the gold shoe.

characters.name: Kari Træstak
characters.description: The disguised form of the King's daughter, appearing as a humble servant in a rough wooden disguise. Despite her plain garb, she displays an air of quiet dignity and patience. The setting shifts dramatically when she reveals herself, shedding the disguise to stand beautifully adorned in royal gold attire, highlighting her transformation and true identity.
